feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Three years on, people in Gaza ask when war will end
entry.summary: American doctors in Gaza tell NPR they saw patients suffering because of Israeli restrictions on aid.

entry.title: Backlash as American tech giants look to build data centers in Australia
entry.summary: Facing legal challenges and public backlash at home, American tech giants are looking abroad for new opportunities in Australia. But the reception down under may not be quite as warm as they hope.

entry.title: Pádraig Ó Tuama on the fear and relief of admitting the truth
entry.summary: Each week, a guest draws a card from NPR's Wild Card deck and answers a big question about their life. Pádraig Ó Tuama's poetry examines faith and sexuality. His new collection is "Love Between Men."

entry.title: Opera singers often quit not because they're done, but because life gets in the way
entry.summary: Opera singers often leave their careers when their voices are at their best, because the workload isn't manageable anymore.

entry.title: Mobile Bay is shutting down in preparation of Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: People on Alabama's Gulf Coast have been preparing or evacuating as Hurricane Isaias is likely to make landfall late Friday as a possible category 2 hurricane with winds around 100 miles per hour.

entry.title: The USS Abraham Lincoln is home in San Diego, after a record deployment
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Rep. Sara Jacobs, D-Calif., about the return of the USS Abraham Lincoln, after some 11 months away from its home base in San Diego, including support in the Iran War.

entry.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software sent humans to the moon, dies at 90
entry.summary: Margaret Hamilton, the computing pioneer whose work helped put humans on the moon, has died at 90. She is also credited with formalizing the discipline of software engineering.

entry.title: Major news outlets and Trump administration return to court over White House ban
entry.summary: Three major news outlets were back in court Thursday to convince a judge the White House is violating their constitutional rights by continuing to block their access to the president.

entry.title: A Congressman wants his colleagues to pledge to accept election results
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Rep. Josh Gottheimer, D-N.Y., on a bipartisan pledge he is co-leading to assure that fellow House members accept midterm elections results.

entry.title: Health Secretary Kennedy touts an initiative to study vaccine safety
entry.summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has established a new clinic at the National Institutes of Health to study vaccine injuries. It's part of a larger administration effort on vaccine safety.
